purpose: Close the version split w44-perf's v0.3.2/v0.4.0/v0.4.3 PROD repeat does not cover: v0.4.1 -> v0.4.2/3 (SWDDIR fix, aot-key private cache, harness C-auto allocator, icloud=0) on BOTH the iteration case and the release-benchmark workload (WN3 par3).

not_in_this_phase.v032/v040: w44-perf repeatcompare (25 Oct, harness S0 + explicit pool .25)
not_in_this_phase.v033/v034: needs snapshot + cold prime (~25 GPU-min); v0.3.4 default program jaxpr-identical to v0.3.3; decision manager/Owner

harness: each version's own product CLI (PROD) / scripts/run_parallel_cases.sh (WN3 par3) inside its sealed bundle consumer (P read-only), release defaults, no GPUWRF_* model flags, no XLA_FLAGS; allocator = each version's own CLI policy (C-auto in v0.4.3; disclosed per arm). This measures what a user runs, not a matched-allocator kernel comparison.

prod: whole_s_per_fch = (last original wrfout mtime - CLI t0) / 3 (E162)
startup_s = first d01 wrfout mtime - t0 minus one steady hour
wn3_par3: steady_case_s_per_h = median d01 hourly mtime gap per case

aa_rule: Per version and metric: (max-min)/mean <= 5 % over its measured arms. Failure => that metric INCONCLUSIVE for that version; no retry, no exclusion, no pooling with other sessions. A version difference is reported only if |diff| > max(5 %, both A/A spreads).
disk: wrfouts deleted after sha per arm; peak <= 4 GB; launcher refuses <DATA_ROOT> < 365 GiB
fidelity: no WRF-fidelity claim (bundles validated at release); wrfout sha recorded for determinism only
